# BASIC_MATERIALS weekly digest — 2026-W46

**Coverage changes.** Thirty-one names published since 7 November.
- NICKEL: BUY ANTM (Rp4,894 vs Rp2,580), ADD NCKL (Rp859 vs Rp723), HOLD INCO (Rp3,227 vs Rp3,168), HOLD IFSH (Rp774 vs Rp772), HOLD DKFT (Rp652 vs Rp630), REDUCE MBMA (Rp245 vs Rp312), SELL NICE (Rp137 vs Rp248)
- PRECIOUS_BASE_METALS: HOLD AMMN (Rp3,660 vs Rp3,590), ADD ARCI (Rp1,179 vs Rp1,007), HOLD BRMS (Rp308 vs Rp310), HOLD EMAS (Rp4,971 vs Rp5,225), HOLD PSAB (Rp368 vs Rp409), SELL SQMI (Rp46 vs Rp83)
- METALS_OTHER: ADD CITA (Rp3,146 vs Rp2,713), BUY NICL (Rp351 vs Rp208), SELL NIKL (Rp18 vs Rp111)
- CEMENT: BUY BLES (Rp413 vs Rp190), BUY INTP (Rp7,215 vs Rp5,230), SELL CMNT (Rp501 vs Rp730)
- CHEMICALS: BUY BMSR (Rp538 vs Rp274), CLPI (Rp2,188 vs Rp1,427), ESSA (Rp682 vs Rp443), LTLS (Rp1,604 vs Rp854), SRSN (Rp125 vs Rp94); HOLD APLI (Rp246 vs Rp256), FPNI (Rp378 vs Rp374); REDUCE SAMF (Rp209 vs Rp245); SELL ADMG (Rp108 vs Rp192), AKPI (Rp90 vs Rp306)
- PULP_PAPER: BUY INKP (Rp10,086 vs Rp6,388), TKIM (Rp9,854 vs Rp6,181)

**Deck moves.** Metals and macro spot refreshed daily: gold US$3,892.8/oz (off the Sep-2026 US$4,319 print), silver US$49.87, copper US$13,559/t, aluminium US$3,125 [metals S2]; USD/IDR Rp18,190 [macro]. Forecasts unchanged — copper FY2027E US$11,000 sits 19% below spot, nickel FY2027E US$17,500 7% above the US$16,324 September print. No coal or konglo review this week (last reviewed 26-Oct and 27-Oct).

**Material news.** The HPM nickel-ore benchmark was revised, lifting limonite pricing [SMM #8b8ad24]. MSCI's November review drops BRPT and BRMS from Global Standard, BRMS falling to Small Cap [Kontan #5d6cb37]. INCO Q3 net profit rose 182% to US$147m [CNBC #02e6959]. ANTM nickel sales rose 52% y/y to Rp16.98tn on 12.16m t of ore to September [#8b74fdf, #4ca0f43]. INTP nine-month revenue rose 8.9% to Rp14.1tn [IDXChannel #199368a].

**What to watch.** The November Pink Sheet; the RKAB nickel-output decree; whether copper closes its spot-to-FY2027E gap from the spot side; INCO and ANTM post-results marks; the LQ45 reshuffle effective 18 November (NCKL out); cement demand into Q4.
